_: Where the Phone app's native remote screen (RemoteScreen.kt, Media.kt, Automation.kt) and the web remote screen (index.html, js/remote.js) are allowed to differ. remote.test.js fails on any other difference. Add a line here only with the reason.

phoneOnly.cast: Android's Cast settings can only be opened from the phone itself; a browser cannot

enDiffers.tv: the phone says 'Live TV'; the page's label is the bare word TV, which i18n.js cannot translate on its own without changing every TV on the page

words._: the phone says 'phone', the web page says 'this device' (it may be a computer): equal after this swap (Vietnamese, English)
